payload.text: ST0002/WP05's run carries two WP03 follow-ups from vc (inbox 2026-11-13, after its PASS of WP03 and WP04): (1) a line gives the headroom as what is below the cap, eg hello: 73% used, 22% below the 95% cap, resets in 3d04h, since hv reads left as what remains of the allowance; (2) hv's ruling 3, that ccusage works for any Claude account and shows whatever it reports: which's text lists an unknown account with the windows it does report, and a CLI test shows an account with a session window only listed as unknown with it, and never chosen.
